svg.text: Contract values bunch below the competition threshold, and the bunching moved when the threshold did
The simplified acquisition threshold was $150,000 through FY2017 and $250,000 from FY2018. Excess is measured against a locally fitted trend, not against a flat line.

USAspending API v2 bulk download, fetched 2026-09-22; FY2016, FY2017 and FY2025, positive awards only. The threshold history is the FAR's. CAVEAT: this is distribution-level -- the
population's shape tracks the rule, and no individual award is identified as split. FY2016's peak is not identified and is not drawn. These eleven civilian departments are 8.5% of
federal contract awards; Defense (68.6%) is absent, so this is not federal procurement as a whole.
